You are all cordially invited to attend the ceremony where I will defend my PhD thesis Formalizing Fundamental Algebraic Number Theory on 2024-01-29T12:45:00Z. The ceremony is open to anyone aged eight or above. Location: Auditorium, Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam. Watch online: https://www.youtube.com/VUBeadlesOffice

My thesis will soon be made available online at the VU library. In the meantime, you can access the latest version on my website.
